calendarFaqs.q: When does the 2026–27 BCPS school year begin?
calendarFaqs.a: The 2026–27 school year begins Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When does the 2026–27 BCPS school year end?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day is Friday, May 28, 2027. It is also an early-release day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break for Broward County Public Schools?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29, unless the district announces a schedule change.

calendarFaqs.q: Which BCPS dates are students off outside the major breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Districtwide no-school days outside the major breaks are September 7 and 21; October 12; November 3 and 11; January 4 and 18; February 15; and March 10 and 19.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the BCPS early-release dates in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists early-release days on October 9, December 18, February 12, March 18, April 30, and May 28. March 18 is shown here as Thursday based on the calendar grid and the actual date.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for BCPS in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. January 4 is an employee planning day, and students return Tuesday, January 5.

customSections.content: These notes explain BCPS-specific details that are easy to miss when reading the official calendar.

groups.label: Severe-weather make-up dates
items: BCPS designates October 9, December 18, March 18, April 30, and May 28 as potential severe-weather make-up dates. They are still listed as early-release days unless BCPS changes the calendar after a closure.

groups.label: Official weekday discrepancies
items: The BCPS synopsis labels November 3, 2026, as Monday and March 18, 2027, as Wednesday. The calendar grid and actual dates place them on Tuesday and Thursday, respectively. This page uses the correct weekdays.
